diagnosis.mechanistic_interpretation: session-stable direction with excessive transport magnitude / session-scale mismatch, not absent directionality

repair.selection_rule: an alpha is eligible only if every competent setting has a passing predeclared layer; prefer alpha=0.5 if both are eligible
repair.failure_terminal_rule: if no alpha is eligible, assign a specific gate failure only when at least one retained setting cannot pass that gate at any frozen alpha/layer, in order subject fidelity, class fidelity, manifold; otherwise TRANSPORT_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE

analytic_source_only_check_before_lock.derivation: exact quadratic distance interpolation from V0 clean distance, alpha=1 distance, and delta norm; no new representation or future outcome access

if_repair1_fails: terminate transport validity; do not train SCST-DR
